description: F4-T2 Markdown round-trip corpus (adopted U-06). `rich`: the pinned @tiptap/markdown 3.31.3 parse -> serialize reproduces the file byte for byte and every token class is supported. `source`: the file opens in Source mode for the listed reasons. Bytes are exact; see .gitattributes.

files.note: headings, emphasis, strong, links (URL bytes kept), strikethrough, code span, hard/soft breaks, thematic break, escapes, trailing newline
bullet, nested bullet, ordered, ordered with start, task lists with nesting
blockquote, nested blockquote, fenced code with info string and backticks inside the code
Arabic/Hebrew RTL, CJK, emoji with skin tone modifier, combining mark
YAML frontmatter (with a blank line inside) preserved as an opaque prefix
UTF-8 BOM + LF
BOM + CRLF + frontmatter: CRLF normalized for the editor and restored on compose, code block included
leading thematic break is prose, not frontmatter
newline style none, no trailing newline
leading and trailing blank lines are opaque parts
empty file
frontmatter with an empty body
GFM table with an escaped pipe: 3.31.3 re-pads cells and adds blank lines
reference links and definitions would be inlined by the serializer
raw HTML and comments would be escaped as text
container directive
footnote with a URL definition lexes as footnote + def and would be rewritten as an inline link
footnote with a prose definition lexes as plain text; the byte check catches the escaped brackets
CommonMark joins ordered lists separated only by a blank line; the serializer renumbers them
display math
images: rich mode never fetches local or remote images
tilde fence would become backticks
indented code would become a fence
setext headings would become ATX
loose list would be tightened
angle autolinks and bare URLs would be rewritten as inline links
4-backtick fence containing a 3-backtick fence would be broken by the serializer
escaped pipe would lose its backslash
underscore emphasis would become asterisks
star bullets would become dashes
capital X task marker would be lowercased
mixed newlines are edited verbatim in Source mode, never normalized silently
